text_block_list.text: One, two… three, four… one, two…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Whew… it seems we're finally beginning to
synchronise. 
Shall we call it here for the day?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: How did you feel about today's dance?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Y-Your dance was lovely as usual,
Ardan-san! Your steps were flawless,
and you were conscious of everything down
to the tips of your fingers!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
But on the other hand I'm just kind of,
like, mediocre,
or like… there's nothing really showy about
me.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
It made me think,
I've gotta work even harder!
I'm pretty average,
so I just have to push myself to aim even
higher!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Hehe… then allow me as your date to help
you in any way I can.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Oh! Thanks so much, Ardan-san!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
G-Good day,
my reliable upperclassmen!
Could you so kindly show me video footage
of your dance practice?!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(And so I went to ask Ardan-san's classmates
and the upperclassmen in my dorm for all
the footage of their past Dorowa dances!)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(After all,
I'm aiming for the Best Date! I may be average,
but that just means I've got to put in every
average ounce of effort that I can!)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(To stand out from everyone else on that day,
I'll do all the research I can—)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: …One day, I'll wear the same crown too…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
The more I go through old footage of dances,
the clearer it becomes that Maruzen-san's
dance on that day was on another level.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
They constantly passed the lead back and forth,
neither falling into a "supporting" role.
It was a bold move,
and a testament to their skill that they
kept their balance.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
It was truly a captivating,
special dance of Maruzen-san's own.
She didn't let herself be constrained by
what's "ordinary" or what came before.
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Chiyono O-san!
How are things?
Is your dress coming along well?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Ah… Y-Yes,
it is.
Are you here on committee business again,
Nature-san?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
I sure am. By the by, you haven't seen McQueen,
have you?
The committee's got a request for her…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san!
They said the dress you ordered the other
day has finally arrived at the estate.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
So, how do you feel about doing some
reconnaissance while trying the dress on?
It seems that McQueen will be practicing
her couple dance at the estate, as well.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! What about you,
Nature-san?
You needed to talk to McQueen-san about
something, right?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
U-Uh, yeah,
that's right!
Hope you don't mind me tagging along,
then.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
I'll go grab my bag real quick from the
classroom!
Let's meet at the school gates in ten
minutes!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Alri… ght.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: …If McQueen's practicing, then she's going to be there too, huh.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha… so you and Ardan-san are aiming for
Best Date, correct?
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've gathered a ton of footage to study,
too! Whoever we trade blows with,
we're not gonna lose!
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
"Trade blows"?
This isn't some sort of down-and-dirty fight,
you know.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
It's not a bad way to prepare ourselves,
however. McQueen and her date,
who we'll shortly be observing,
are also aiming for Best Date this year.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Because they're our rivals.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
That's right,
Ardan-san! No matter who comes at us,
I'll——
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Teio-san!

Ahaha! Don't get distracted now,
McQueen! You can… keep up with me,
can't you?
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Hmph,
of course! It's time for the next turn!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
Heck yeah! This is awesome! ♪ Okay,
one more time! Last one—! ♪
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Woah,
they're already pros at it.
Seriously… McQueen's insanely good.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text: …Teio, too.
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
(Oh, wow… they're amazing. Their sharp turns,
their deft movements… compared to them,
I'm just…)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: (These two… aren't "ordinary" at all.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
Whew… ahh,
I'm pooped! That suit's way too stuffy! Wait,
huh? Nature? Uwah,
what're you doing here?!
text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, y'see,
the Dorowa committee has some business with
McQueen here, so…
text_block_list.name: Nice Nature

text_block_list.text:
Oh, might this be about volunteering?
I see they've decided on the lesson schedule
for the applicants, then.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen

text_block_list.text:
…Lessons?
You mean McQueen's gonna teach everyone else
at school, too?
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text: Ha… ahahah…
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(I thought I'd learn a bunch of different
dances from the recordings.
But seeing it in person,
the intensity is totally different.
It shattered all my expectations.)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O

text_block_list.text:
(If I can't win against these two,
I can't win Best Date. Some dark,
heavy feeling's punched a deep,
deep hole in my chest…)
text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
